operation: Offline metric supplement to closed Nov1 daily and cumulative report; no new GPU measurement, no live remote check.

metrics.output_throughput_tok_s: Sum of actual output_len of successful, length-validated formal requests / saved measurement duration_s. Four-GPU service total; prefill and drain included; warmup, service restart and initialization excluded.
metrics.slo_output_throughput_tok_s: Sum of actual output_len of successful formal requests meeting TTFT<=500ms and TPOT<=30ms / the same duration_s. Rejected requests add zero output; thresholds remain research-only.
metrics.mean_aggregation: Within each workload and configuration, calculate each round independently then give equal weight to3 rounds; do not pool intervals or duplicate reused offline-analysis requests.
metrics.offered_rate_limit: Under a fixed arrival schedule, output throughput is limited by offered rate and output length; it is not maximum model capacity and can stay similar while TPOT worsens.
metrics.not_equivalent: 1000/mean TPOT is a per-request generation-rate conversion, not aggregate system throughput; offered_rate*configured_output_length is only a planned output rate, not a measured throughput.

micro_limit: ABBA micro blocks mix output1 and128 within one measurement duration. Do not label a subgroup token count / shared block duration as its independent single-stream throughput. Use the prior pure C1 baseline for that reference.

earlier_goodput_aggregates.source_verification: Uses prior verified output_throughput field; recomputed against fixed128 outputs, successful count and saved full duration. No new raw request reanalysis for this earlier stage.
